feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: NPR world news, international art and culture, world business and financial markets, world economy, and global trends in health, science and technology. Subscribe to the World Story of the Day podcast and RSS feed.

entry.title: U.S. and Russia tout diesel deal to ease sanctions and reopen fuel flows
entry.summary: Moscow and Washington tout a diesel deal to ease sanctions and reopen fuel flows, but few details leave questions on price impacts and U.S. policy, sparking anger from Ukraine and allies.

entry.title: A year of ceasefire in Gaza through the lens of NPR's reporter
entry.summary: It has been one year since Hamas released the remaining Israeli hostages and President Trump promised an end to the war, but Palestinians say the past 12 months have been a ceasefire in name only.

entry.title: India cracks down on youth protests as anger grows against Modi and election chief
entry.summary: Indian authorities have launched a major security crackdown in New Delhi, detaining thousands of protesters who intended to hold a mass demonstration against Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government.

entry.title: South African human rights lawyer Navi Pillay wins Nobel Peace Prize
entry.summary: South African human rights lawyer Navi Pillay wins the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for her lifelong defense of human rights and international law.

entry.title: Trump says U.S. to get diesel from Russia, relaxing pressure on Moscow to ease prices before midterms
entry.summary: Trump says the U.S. will obtain diesel from Russia, relaxing years of U.S. pressure on Moscow, to combat prices before midterms. He said he struck the deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin in a phone call.

entry.title: Did Russia play by the rules in reporting lab worker's death?
entry.summary: A global treaty signed by 197 countries — including Russia — requires reporting any death that could be a sign of an outbreak to come.

entry.title: Trump says U.S. won't attack Iran before midterms. And, ICE agent shoots man in NYC
entry.summary: Trump announced that the U.S. will not attack Iran ahead of the midterms. And, a 28-year-old man is receiving treatment at the hospital after an ICE agent shot him in the neck.

entry.title: South African human rights lawyer Navi Pillay wins the Nobel Peace Prize
entry.summary: South African human rights lawyer Navi Pillay wins the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for advancing human rights and international law.

entry.title: The long-deployed USS Lincoln returns home to San Diego Bay
entry.summary: The USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier has returned home after a record-setting uninterrupted time at sea supporting the Iran war. The extended deployment drew attention following reports of crew stress and supply shortages.

entry.title: New U.S. indictment charges former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro with torture
entry.summary: U.S. authorities added new torture charges to their case against former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro, ramping up pressure on the ousted authoritarian leader already fighting drug trafficking allegations.
